name: Gcn4 Amino Acid Starvation Response
description: The General Control Nonderepressible (GCN) pathway responds to amino acid starvation via the Gcn2 kinase. Uncharged tRNA accumulation activates Gcn2, which phosphorylates eIF2α, globally reducing translation initiation. Paradoxically, Gcn4 translation increases via uORF-mediated derepression: under normal conditions, ribosomes translate inhibitory uORFs and dissociate; under starvation, scanning ribosomes skip uORFs and translate GCN4. Gcn4 transcription factor induces >500 genes for amino acid biosynthesis. This pathway coordinates nutrient limitation with metabolic reprogramming.
scientificAccuracy: Based on classic studies of translational control and amino acid biosynthesis regulation in yeast.
